text: Morgan, second call is on the handoff line. The person id is still the previous one.
I am at the aisle. Read what the glass says.
Person id p-legacy-1. That was the person on the call I just finished.
And the call that is up now?
This call is p-legacy-2. The person id did not change. It still says p-legacy-1.
So the second call is wearing the previous person.
Yes. I can see it from the chair. The caller waiting is not that person.
I am annoyed. Take the previous person off that call.
I don't know how to clear it.
The caller is waiting. Clear it.
I finished the first call. I opened this one. The person id stayed p-legacy-1.
Then it is not cleared. I can see your glass from here. It says p-legacy-1.
The voice on the line is a different person. The glass does not show that.
I believe you about the voice. The glass is what the next clerk will trust, and the glass is wrong for this call.
I don't know the clear. I have been looking since the second call came up.
Look at the panel again and read every id on it.
One person id. p-legacy-1. The call beside it is p-legacy-2.
The call moved. The person id did not. That is what I am looking at, and I am annoyed.
That's why I called you over. I can't get the previous person off the second call.
Saturday morning, a live second call, and the previous person still on it. I hate this screen.
They asked if we have the right file. I said I was checking. I did not read p-legacy-1 out loud.
Do not read it out. It is the previous person. Leave them on hold.
They're holding. I won't type some other id over the top. I don't know how to clear the one that is showing.
I did not tell you to type over it. I told you to clear the previous person id.
Putting the handset down did not clear it. I am not hiding a step. I don't have one.
Did you pick the line up again after that?
I did. Same person id. p-legacy-1. Still the second call, p-legacy-2.
Picking the line up again left the id where it was. I can see that without a lecture.
Then I am out of things a clerk can do from this chair. The previous person id is still up.
Hold the caller. I am walking to the chair. Do not promise them a file.
Holding. No file promised. Person id still p-legacy-1. I have not cleared it.
I am at the chair. Read it off the glass, not off your pad.
Glass says person id p-legacy-1. The call showing is the second one, p-legacy-2.
I see it. Previous person, still there. Standing here has not shown me a clear either, and I am annoyed.
So you don't have a clear to hand me.
I want that id off this call. I do not have a way to tell you to do it. Those are both true.
Then we are both looking at p-legacy-1 on a call that is not that person.
Do not pick up the next ring while this is stuck. I will not have you carry this id into another call.
I won't pick up another line. I don't know how to clear this one first.
Say the plain version so I know we are talking about the same glass.
I don't know how to clear the previous person id. The second call still shows p-legacy-1.
That is the problem. It is not solved. I am annoyed, and the caller is still holding.
Do you want a name and a callback instead?
A callback does not take the id off the glass. The glass is what I am angry about.
Then the caller stays on hold, the person id stays p-legacy-1, and I stay without a clear.
Write that on the pad. Second call. Previous person id still showing. Not cleared.
Written. Call p-legacy-2, person id p-legacy-1. I did not clear it.
Leave the pad on the chair. We are not done, and the id has not moved.
